# Cross-workflow required status checks
#
# This file lists jobs defined OUTSIDE .github/workflows/ci.yml that are
# (or should be) configured as required status checks in branch protection
# for `main`. The all-checks gate in ci.yml uses this allowlist to verify
# that every job in every workflow file is covered by either:
#   - ci.yml's `jobs.all-checks.needs` (for jobs in ci.yml), or
#   - this file (for jobs in other workflow files).
#
# Format: one entry per line, `<workflow-file-basename-without-extension>/<job-id>`.
# Lines beginning with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
#
# When adding a new job to a workflow file other than ci.yml:
#   1. If the job should block merges to main, add an entry here AND
#      configure it as a required status check in branch protection.
#   2. If the job is intentionally optional (informational, dispatch-only,
#      release-only, etc.), add it to the OPTIONAL section below so the
#      gate can still account for it.
#
# IMPORTANT: this file is documentation/enumeration only -- it does NOT
# itself enforce required-status-check status. Actual merge enforcement
# lives in branch-protection settings. The string used in branch
# protection is `<workflow `name:`> / <job `name:` or job-id>`
# (with spaces around the slash) -- e.g. `codecov-guard / guard` --
# whereas the entries in this file use the slug
# `<workflow-filename-without-extension>/<job-id>` (no spaces).
# See AGENTS.md "Adding a new CI job" for details.
#
# Required (must be green to merge):
codecov-guard/guard
ci-integration/container-loading
ci-integration/empty-cache
ci-integration/expected-failure

# Optional / dispatch-only / scheduled (not required for merge, but
# enumerated so the gate accounts for every job in every workflow file):
cache-warming/summary
cache-warming/warm-containers
cache-warming/warm-cross-platform
cache-warming/warm-dependencies
eval/eval
badges/update-badges
